name: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd
title: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd - 543596 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 print beat prior guidance across the board (ROA 2.05%, ROE 15.03%, GNPA 0.73%), but management guided to moderating NIM and ROA in FY27 and admits Q4 margin is hard to sustain.

capex.quote: my technology spend this year is 15.80% higher

triggers.label: Q4 NIM 4.18% vs 4.04% QoQ
triggers.quote: this kind of level is going to be very difficult to sustain

triggers.label: FY27 ROA guided 1.9-2% (from 2.05%)
triggers.quote: we are still looking at a 1.9% to 2% kind of ROA for FY27

triggers.label: Gold loan growth moderating; MSME up 14.88%
triggers.quote: MSME is another story that we have. MSME, if you recall, has been degrowing until as late as the first quarter of FY26

triggers.label: Cost of deposits 5.83% → 5.71% QoQ
triggers.quote: our cost of deposit has quarter-on-quarter sequentially has moved down from 5.83% to 5.71%

triggers.label: ECL transition ₹279 cr impact from April 2027
triggers.quote: should have a INR279 crores impact

guidance.quote: in FY27, we will grow at least 1% higher than what we did in FY26
the advances that we did of 20% is something that we will defend in the current year as well
we are still looking at a 1.9% to 2% kind of ROA for FY27
we should be looking at defending 14% to 15% for FY27
we'll be able to defend a 3.9% to 4% NIM
we are committed to keep it below 50% and should be in the 46%, 47% range
We are proposing 60 branches in FY27
INR500 crores of operating profit will certainly be defended

prior_guidance_check.quote: For the quarter, the net interest margin, 4.18%.
we have actually able to break the 15% mark, and it is at 15.03%
GNPA, as a consequence of the kind of efforts we have taken is at 0.73%
We have been able to open only 44 branches

red_flags.label: Gold loan price sensitivity / LTV definition
red_flags.quote: the LTV is calculated not on the gross rate of the portfolio, but on the net rate

red_flags.label: Large single NPA account ₹164 cr, NCLT
red_flags.quote: I think it is one account, that INR164 crores

red_flags.label: Gold loan reclassification retail vs agri
red_flags.quote: there was a shift from agri gold loans to retail loans in the third quarter

red_flags.label: Write-offs ₹149.69 cr in FY26
red_flags.quote: we have written off INR149.69 crores

evasions.quote: No, no, no. That will be in the 75%, right? And it varies
We do have a target, but that's a slightly longest target, and I don't think I should be looking at.
We are not done in the year. See, we just quickly a snapshot of it.
